Content creators looking to produce faceless or AI-generated channels
Marketing professionals needing rapid video prototyping

target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Absolute beginners who have never touched a video timeline should take Premiere Pro or Reels Editing first.

prerequisites.required: Basic understanding of video editing timelines and concepts.
prerequisites.recommended: Prior experience with Premiere Pro or CapCut.

system_requirements.hardware: Modern laptop/desktop with a stable, high-speed internet connection.
system_requirements.software_accounts: Runway ML, HeyGen, Descript, Midjourney, Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut.

overview.positioning: The cutting-edge program for modern creators leveraging AI to automate, generate, and accelerate video production.
overview.short_description: Master AI-assisted workflows, text-to-video generation, AI avatars, and automated post-production using Runway, HeyGen, and Descript.

key_facts.career_focus: AI Content Creator, Next-Gen Video Editor

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Generate high-quality b-roll and cinematic shots from text prompts
Edit video like a text document using Descript
Create hyper-realistic AI avatars and cloned voices for faceless content
Automate captioning, framing, and color matching

why_now.industry_shift: The barrier to entry for high-quality production is dropping; speed and ideation are becoming the primary competitive advantages.
why_now.ai_impact: Generative video models (Runway Gen-2, Pika, Sora) are replacing stock footage and manual VFX tasks.
why_now.business_demand: Agencies and brands want 'more content, faster.' AI editors can deliver 5x the volume of traditional editors.
why_now.career_opportunity: First-mover advantage in AI video allows editors to charge premium rates for rapid turnaround and impossible visuals.

learning_outcomes: GENERATE: Create cinematic video from text, image, and video prompts.
AUTOMATE: Speed up rough cuts and transcription using text-based editing.
SYNTHESIZE: Build custom AI avatars and clone voices for scalable production.
INTEGRATE: Combine AI assets flawlessly into traditional editing timelines.

Avatars, lip-sync, and voice cloning (HeyGen, ElevenLabs).
Combining AI elements in Premiere/CapCut for final delivery.

Rapidly edited podcast and talking-head videos.

core_tools.what_student_builds: Faceless YouTube content and localized ad variations.

industry_workflow.overview: The modern AI-accelerated content creation pipeline.

stages.name: Ideation & Scripting
stages.desc: Using ChatGPT to outline structure and script content.

stages.name: Asset Generation
stages.desc: Prompting Midjourney and Runway for visual assets; ElevenLabs for voiceover.

stages.name: Automated Assembly
stages.desc: Using Descript to align text and generate the rough cut.

stages.name: VFX & Inpainting
stages.desc: Using Runway to remove objects or extend backgrounds.

stages.name: Final Polish
stages.desc: Color matching, motion blur, and final export in Premiere/CapCut.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Producing daily high-quality YouTube videos is too slow and expensive.
Need to translate a CEO announcement into 5 languages with perfect lip-sync.
business_use_cases.output: Multilingual video variations from one source clip.

ai_integration.ai_can_automate: Multilingual lip-sync translation, rotoscoping, silence removal.
ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Brand alignment, ethical considerations, and narrative arc pacing.
ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Curating the best AI generations and blending them seamlessly.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Checking AI avatars for uncanny valley artifacts and ensuring copyright safety.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Disclosing synthetic media where necessary and avoiding deepfake misuse.

best_practices: Treat AI as an assistant, not a replacement for good storytelling.
Always do a 'human polish' pass on AI-generated rough cuts.
Use reference images (Image-to-Video) rather than pure Text-to-Video for consistency.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Generative AI often morphs and hallucinates over long durations.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Keep AI clips under 3 seconds and cut frequently to hide morphing.
Use ElevenLabs and manually adjust pacing, emphasis, and emotion tags.

career_paths.employer_expectations: Ability to turn ideas into video 5x faster than traditional editors using AI tools.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A portfolio of high-quality synthetic media and automated workflows.

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Script Approval -> Voice Clone generation -> AI B-Roll generation -> Polish -> Delivery

faq.question: Will AI replace video editors?
faq.answer: No, but editors using AI will replace editors who don't. AI handles the boring parts; you handle the storytelling.

faq.question: Do I need a powerful computer to generate AI video?
faq.answer: Most of the tools we use (Runway, HeyGen, Midjourney) are cloud-based, so a basic laptop with a good internet connection is sufficient.

faq.question: Are there additional costs for the AI tools?
faq.answer: Yes, while many have free tiers, producing professional work will require monthly subscriptions to platforms like Runway and ElevenLabs.

modules.module_purpose: Radically speed up your traditional editing workflow using text-based editing and audio AI.

lessons.what_is_taught: Transcribing footage and editing video by deleting text, removing filler words, and gap removal.
lessons.why_it_matters: Cuts rough-cut time by 80% for podcasts, interviews, and courses.
lessons.what_learner_does: Edits a 30-minute podcast down to 5 minutes by editing the text transcript.
lessons.expected_outcome: A tightened, filler-free rough cut produced in minutes.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using Adobe Podcast AI and Premiere's Enhance Speech to fix terrible audio.
lessons.why_it_matters: Rescues unusable footage recorded in echoey rooms or windy environments.
lessons.what_learner_does: Restores audio recorded on a cheap microphone in a noisy street.
lessons.expected_outcome: Studio-quality audio from a bad source.

lessons.what_is_taught: Generating ultra-realistic text-to-speech and cloning your own voice.
lessons.why_it_matters: Allows for script changes in post-production without needing the talent to re-record.
lessons.what_learner_does: Clones their voice and generates a voiceover for a commercial.

modules.hands_on_practice: Edit a messy interview and replace a flubbed line using AI voice cloning.
modules.assignment: Deliverable: A seamless 2-minute interview edit with AI-corrected audio.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to handle dialogue editing 10x faster.

modules.module_purpose: Generate stunning B-roll, cinematic shots, and animations directly from text prompts.

lessons.what_is_taught: Structuring prompts for Runway Gen-2 and Pika: subject, action, environment, camera, and style.
lessons.why_it_matters: Bad prompts yield morphing, unusable garbage; good prompts yield cinematic stock footage.
lessons.expected_outcome: A library of custom AI stock footage.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using Midjourney images as base frames, and using motion brushes to animate specific areas (e.g., water flowing).
lessons.why_it_matters: Image-to-video provides far more consistency and aesthetic control than text-to-video.
lessons.what_learner_does: Animates a still sci-fi concept art piece into a cinematic pan.
lessons.expected_outcome: A highly controlled, beautiful AI shot.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using Gen-1 or DomoAI to turn live-action footage into anime, claymation, or 3D styles.
lessons.why_it_matters: A massive trend in music videos and social media content.
lessons.what_learner_does: Converts a dance video into a 3D animated character.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using Topaz Video AI or CapCut to upscale 720p AI generations to 4K and smooth out frame rates.
lessons.why_it_matters: Most AI video models output low-res, 24fps video. Upscaling is required for professional use.

modules.hands_on_practice: Generate a 30-second mood piece using purely AI-generated clips.
modules.business_application: Pitch viz, mood boards, and generating custom B-roll.

modules.module_purpose: Create and direct AI avatars for scalable, faceless video production and localized content.

lessons.what_is_taught: Selecting avatars, inputting scripts, controlling gestures, and integrating custom voices.
lessons.why_it_matters: Allows brands to create daily content without booking studios or human talent.
lessons.what_learner_does: Generates a 1-minute corporate training video using an AI presenter.

lessons.what_is_taught: Recording the training footage, lighting requirements, and training a custom HeyGen avatar.
lessons.why_it_matters: Creators can scale themselves, producing content while they sleep.
lessons.what_learner_does: Plans and shoots the footage required to train a personal digital twin.
lessons.expected_outcome: A personalized AI avatar ready for scripting.

lessons.what_is_taught: Translating an English video into Spanish/French while preserving the original voice tone and adjusting lip movements.
lessons.why_it_matters: Massive value-add for YouTubers and businesses wanting to go global.
lessons.what_learner_does: Translates a 30-second video into 3 different languages.

modules.hands_on_practice: Create a multilingual social media ad campaign.
modules.assignment: Deliverable: One ad rendered in English, Spanish, and Japanese.
modules.business_application: Global marketing, YouTube dubbing, and corporate training.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to scale on-camera talent infinitely.

modules.module_purpose: Blend AI-generated assets with traditional editing techniques to create a flawless final product.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using Runway's Magic Tools to remove objects from live-action video or rotoscope complex subjects.
lessons.why_it_matters: Turns hours of manual VFX work into seconds of processing.
lessons.what_learner_does: Removes unwanted people from a busy street shot.

lessons.lesson_title: Color Matching AI to Live Action
lessons.what_is_taught: Using Premiere's Auto Color Match to ensure AI-generated B-roll blends seamlessly with camera footage.
lessons.why_it_matters: AI clips often have baked-in, hyper-stylized looks that scream 'AI'.
lessons.what_learner_does: Color grades a sequence blending iPhone footage with Runway AI footage.

lessons.what_is_taught: Managing the entire pipeline: ChatGPT script -> Midjourney storyboard -> Runway Generation -> ElevenLabs VO -> Premiere Assembly -> CapCut Captions.
lessons.why_it_matters: Proves mastery over the entire modern AI post-production pipeline.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a 60-second commercial using 100% AI-generated assets.

modules.business_application: Producing high-end creative work with zero budget for shoots.
modules.expected_outcome: A professional, fully realized AI video production.
